test.note: no 2018 flow enters test; the zero-day definition stays 2017's

control.why: isolates the augmentation from the 67-vs-68 input-width change; the dropped column is a verified duplicate but the architecture is not identical

caveats: This arm confounds 'wider basis' with 'twice the data'. The NARROW control (equal added volume from a single family group) is specified in the docstring and is built only if WIDE moves the headline.
2018's known pool is DDoS/DoS/FTP-BruteForce/SSH-Bruteforce - the same categories 2017 already trains on - so the basis widens in directions it already covered.
2018 class counts are lower bounds: 7 of 10 published CSVs are Excel-truncated at 2^20 rows, chronologically.
The falsifier is evaluated PAIRED against the seed-matched baseline, not against the n=3 mean 0.6399.

The paired baseline is the 67-FEATURE 2017-only control (paper_67), not the historical 68-feature cnn_paper: the augmented model has a different input width and therefore a different flatten dimension.
